about_the_game:
Bombardiro Crocodilo: The Naked Clue is a visual novel where characters from the Italian Brainrot memes dive into a world of noir detective fiction, filled with absurd humor and ridiculous investigations. Alongside Bombardiro Crocodilo, Ballerina Cappuccina, and other iconic characters, you'll find yourself in an atmosphere of gritty streets, strange conspiracies, and unbelievable twists, where every step may lead to unpredictable consequences.

Game Features:

  • Meme characters such as Bombardiro Crocodilo, Ballerina Cappuccina, Tung Tung Tung Sahur and other iconic figures from Italian Brainrot brought to life in a detective story.

  • A noir atmosphere, typical of 1960s detective fiction.

  • Satire, dark humor, and dumb (yet funny) jokes.

Dive into a world where memes come to life, with absurd humor inspired by classics like The Naked Gun and Archer.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a parody of the detective genre. It contains scenes of violence, depictions of criminal activity, and suggestive sexual themes. Therefore, it may not be suitable for all audiences.
